title: Organic substances: names and groups - 123 school
heading: Organic substances: names and groups
intro: These questions are about hydrocarbons, functional groups, names and isomerism.
Test your knowledge by typing your answer and comparing it with the correct answer. Then click 'Check answers'.

questions.q: What is a hydrocarbon?
questions.a: A substance whose molecules consist only of C atoms and H atoms

questions.q: What is the general formula of alkanes (open chain)?
What is the general formula of alkenes (open chain) and what is characteristic of an alkene?
questions.a: C<sub>n</sub>H<sub>2n</sub>. An alkene has a double bond C=C

questions.q: What are the names of the first four alkanes (1 to 4 C atoms)?
Which stem names belong to 5, 6, 7 and 8 C atoms in the chain?
Give the molecular formula of hexane
Give the molecular formula of propene
What is the functional group of an alcohol and which suffix belongs to it?
What is the functional group of a carboxylic acid and which suffix belongs to it?
questions.a: The carboxyl group –COOH; suffix -oic acid (for example ethanoic acid)

questions.q: What is the difference between an aldehyde and a ketone?
questions.a: In an aldehyde the C=O group is at the end of the chain (–CHO), in a ketone it is in the middle of the chain

questions.q: Which functional group does an amine have?
From which two kinds of substances is an ester formed?
questions.a: From an alcohol and a carboxylic acid (with the loss of water)

questions.q: Give the word equation for the formation of an ester
Which functional group is in an ester?
Give the name of CH<sub>3</sub>–CH<sub>2</sub>–OH
Give the name of CH<sub>3</sub>–COOH
Give the name of CH<sub>3</sub>–CO–CH<sub>3</sub>
Give the name of CH<sub>3</sub>–CH<sub>2</sub>–CH<sub>2</sub>–CHO
Give the name of the ester formed from methanol and propanoic acid
What is the name of a side chain with 1 C atom, –CH<sub>3</sub>?
What are isomers?
questions.a: Substances with the same molecular formula but a different structural formula

questions.q: Draw or describe two isomers of C<sub>4</sub>H<sub>10</sub>
How many isomers does C<sub>5</sub>H<sub>12</sub> have?
Name two isomers with molecular formula C<sub>3</sub>H<sub>8</sub>O that are both alcohols
Why does ethanol have a much higher boiling point than ethane?
questions.a: Between ethanol molecules there are hydrogen bonds (via the –OH group), between ethane molecules only weak van der Waals forces

questions.q: Why does the boiling point of alkanes increase with the length of the chain?
questions.a: Larger molecules have stronger van der Waals forces

questions.q: How can you distinguish an alkane from an alkene with bromine water?
questions.a: An alkene decolourises bromine water (addition), an alkane does not

questions.q: What type of reaction is the reaction of an alkene with bromine?
What is a saturated hydrocarbon?
questions.a: A hydrocarbon with only single bonds between the C atoms (for example an alkane)

questions.q: Give the equation for the complete combustion of methane
Which substance has a cis and a trans form: but-1-ene or but-2-ene? Explain
questions.a: But-2-ene: each C atom of the double bond carries two different groups (H and CH<sub>3</sub>). In but-1-ene one C atom of the double bond carries two H atoms
